title: Wiring the action into the workflow

steps.title: Add the step
steps.body: Builders add a custom action as a step in Agent Builder.

steps.title: Bind the inputs
steps.body: Inputs can be fixed values, user inputs, or AI-predicted values.

steps.title: Compose
steps.body: Combine the custom action with By Glean and By datasource actions in the same workflow.

steps.title: Return something usable
steps.body: The onboarding example returns a request ID plus a link, so downstream steps and users have a handle.
